items.text: Nico Collins hurt his hamstring during Wednesday's practice (Houston Chronicle); missed five games with a hammy in 2024. Crucial MRI results expected tomorrow. Week 1 routes on 42 Stroud dropbacks: Collins 37, Hutchinson 29, Boutte 27.
items.why: Hamstring history and practice limitation raise multi-week risk; high route share makes absence costly.
items.implication: Monitor MRI; if OUT, volume to Hutchinson/Boutte/Noel.
items.opportunity: High routes/targets if active; handcuff-like upside for backups if sidelined.

items.text: Chargers WR Ladd McConkey (rib) did not practice Wednesday; Harbaugh previously day-to-day after leaving Week 1 early.
items.why: Missed first practice post-injury; signed MVS as depth.
items.implication: Questionable for Week 2 vs Raiders; monitor Thu/Fri.
items.opportunity: If OUT, snaps/routes to Quentin Johnston and Tre Harris.

items.text: Deebo Samuel is a top waiver wire target this week (FF Happy Hour); beneficiary of Stribling surgery/OUT (~10 weeks).
items.why: Role expansion with Stribling long-term out (surgery deltoid).
items.implication: Add immediately; startable WR upside in 49ers offense.

items.text: Patriots WR A.J. Brown placed on IR with high-ankle sprain; miss at least 4 games (earliest Week 6), no surgery. Beneficiaries Doubs/Hollins/Douglas.
items.implication: Out through early season; Drake Maye targets redistribute.
items.opportunity: Romeo Doubs, DeMario Douglas, Mack Hollins role expansion.

items.text: Patriots RB TreVeyon Henderson (ankle) was a full participant in Wednesday practice, indication he could return Sunday.
items.implication: Likely ACTIVE Week 2; role expansion possible.
items.opportunity: Carries/routes if Rhamondre shares or limited.

items.text: Broncos RB RJ Harvey did not practice Wednesday due to a hamstring injury.
items.opportunity: Backup RBs (e.g. Jonah Coleman per reports) gain if OUT.

items.text: Bengals QB Joe Burrow dealing with back tightness, did not practice Wednesday, but expects to play Sunday at Houston; got mental reps.
items.opportunity: Full volume for Chase/Higgins if healthy.

items.text: Seahawks ruled out QB Sam Darnold for Sunday vs Cardinals (glute); no plans for IR.
items.implication: Drew Lock or backup starts; impacts Seahawks pass-catchers.
items.opportunity: JSN/Price etc. may see altered volume/script.

items.text: Brock Bowers (left knee meniscus trim) has legit chance to return Week 2 or 3; same knee had PCL/bone bruise last year. Scary but optimistic. DNP Wednesday, day-to-day, hopes to practice later in week.
items.why: Meniscus trim recovery; coach hopeful for practice.
items.implication: If IN, elite TE usage; if OUT, Mayer elevated.
items.opportunity: Goal-line/red-zone if returns; reverse Mayer stash.

items.text: Kenneth Walker true workhorse in Chiefs debut: 29 of first 32 RB opps, 19 routes on 33 dropbacks, tied team-high 6 targets (22% share), 23-173-1 rush + 3-18-1 rec.
items.why: Dominant early-down + pass-game share as expected.
items.implication: RB1 every-week starter ROS; full-grown-man role.

items.text: Ashton Jeanty tied Bijan for No.1 Utilization Score (99); 73% snaps, 70% rushes, 61% routes, 21% targets, 23 att/6 tgt, 156 yds/2 TDs. Upgrades to high-end RB1 every-down player.
items.why: Dominant multi-phase share + efficiency bump behind better OL.
items.implication: Must-start RB1 ROS; history of similar shares = 23+ PPG.

items.text: Jameson Williams had the 8th-most expected fantasy points at WR in Week 1 but simply played a horrific game.
items.implication: Positive regression candidate; hold/start with confidence.
items.opportunity: Continued high-value targets in Lions offense.

items.text: Rashee Rice tiny career aDOT 4.9 (2.5 Week 1); needs volume. Only 2 targets (7% share) but routes strong: 29 on 33 Mahomes dropbacks (behind Worthy 30).
items.why: Routes present for short-area work; volume key to payoff.
items.implication: Monitor target share growth; viable if volume rises.

items.text: Travis Etienne (with Kamara out) only 58% snaps/43% attempts/38% routes in 3-way committee; efficient but volume concerns. Downgrades to low-end RB2 pending Kamara return.
items.why: Split work despite high play volume; Kamara specialty two-minute.
items.implication: Flex/RB2 with risk; Kendre Miller stash if Kamara returns limited.
items.opportunity: If Kamara OUT longer, Etienne rebounds; else Miller.
